sentence: I was hungry because I didn't eat since morning.
ruleVi: Việc kéo dài đến một mốc trong quá khứ (since morning) dùng had + V3.

sentence: She had never saw the sea before that trip.
ruleVi: Quá khứ hoàn thành: had + quá khứ phân từ; see → seen.

sentence: I couldn't get in because I have lost my keys.
ruleVi: Mất chìa khoá xảy ra trước khi không vào được, nên dùng had + V3.

sentence: After he had finish dinner, he watched TV.
ruleVi: Had + quá khứ phân từ: finished.

sentence: By the time the police came, the thief has escaped.
ruleVi: By the time + quá khứ đơn, mệnh đề kia dùng quá khứ hoàn thành.

sentence: Lan was tired because she had work all day.
ruleVi: Had + quá khứ phân từ: worked.

sentence: Did you ever been to Hanoi before you moved there?
ruleVi: Trải nghiệm trước một mốc quá khứ: Had you ever been ...?

sentence: The bus had already leave when I got to the station.
ruleVi: Had already + quá khứ phân từ: leave → left.

sentence: Minh realised he had wrote the wrong address.
ruleVi: Had + quá khứ phân từ: write → written.

sentence: They had not ate anything since breakfast.
ruleVi: Had not + quá khứ phân từ: eat → eaten.
